verdict.rationale: Pigment's official MCP server lets external assistants such as ChatGPT or Claude ask business questions and get answers 'grounded in your business truth', and the platform itself runs variance analysis and KPIs such as projected year-end cash. That suggests the figures come from the platform rather than from the model, but it is only a marketing-level claim. Data-block edit histories are an audit trail of edits, not lineage attached to the answers an agent receives. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that agent-facing figures are computed by the calculation engine rather than generated by the LLM, lineage or traceability returned with answers, runway/forecast query examples via MCP, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can ask the model a finance question (runway, forecast, variance) and the figures come from the platform's calculation engine with lineage, not from a language model's guess

citations.quote: teams can ask questions of the business in ChatGPT or Claude and get accurate answers grounded in your business truth.
Run variance analysis on the same platform you build your budget.
your applications each have detailed histories down to the data block level, which offer full visibility into the edit events
